dataset: ALS Höhen aktuell DGM UTM33N, official classified-ground mosaic
vertical_datum: Official Austrian Gebrauchshöhen as delivered by the DGM service; local road elevations are relative to the filtered minimum. No conversion to ellipsoidal heights.
acquisition_note: The current mosaic combines older 1 m DGM and ALS2022–2023 0.5 m tiles covering the venue. The retained unstyled numeric export is reproducible; its per-pixel flight selection is not claimed as a single survey epoch.
attribution: Land Steiermark / GIS-Steiermark, ALS DGM. Modified by bounded numeric export, centreline sampling, a 2 m Gaussian filter and relative datum removal.
coordinate_registration: Invert the retained source origin and uniform scale at every native road sample, transform WGS84 to EPSG:32633, then bilinearly sample the unstyled F32 DGM at raster pixel centres. The raceway plan is unchanged.
interpolation: Circular Gaussian sigma 2 m, truncated at 3 sigma, suppresses centimetre lidar/export noise. Maximum alteration of any raw height is 0.0444 m. Linear sampling of the dense filtered data supplies 4 m native controls plus independent retained source anchors and extrema; the last height equals the first. No grade clipping or vertical scaling.
uncertainty_note: These are road-reconstruction allowances, not a claimed surveying accuracy. The centreline has not been independently registered to an orthophoto; a 2 m horizontal mismatch and crossfall can affect the sampled height.
supersedes: The 2016 Formula1 profile graphic digitisation retained in Git through 9392048. It introduced a 13.54% slope before T1; the ground raster independently places the steepest climb on the T2–T3 approach, as the circuit operator describes.

primary_crosscheck.note: Do not scale the measured 63.34 m road relief to a rounded operator description. The independently sampled grades approximately match the published 12%/9.3% maxima.

limitations: A classified DGM is not an as-built asphalt survey. Source interpolation removes bridges; inspect any access tunnel or bridge independently before adopting the underlying height.
The road crossfall has been checked locally but is not applied by this elevation-only correction. Native banking and widths remain unchanged.
Surrounding scenery ground is separate; a retained terrain manifest is only supplied after full original coverage is verified.
